🚨 "THERE IS NO SIN A LIAR CANNOT COMMIT!" - VEN. THITTAGALLE THERO SLAMS PRESIDENT & GOVT 🏛️🇱🇰

Ven. Thittagalle Anandasiri Thero has launched a scathing attack on the President and the current administration!

Citing traditional Buddhist teachings, the Thero declared: "There is no sin a liar cannot commit, and this President lies." He pledged to defeat what he termed an "unrighteous government" through the power of Dhamma. 🛑🗣️
